messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: invalidateYield
parts:
Hi,

  I'm thinking about enabling asynchrony in shiny in a couple ways.  

  1) asynchronous URL fetches.  I have a half finished implementation for this
  2) lazy lists in R

  For the second, I need to be able to indicate that a reactive, which is otherwise invalidated, should NOT re-evaluate until after all pending writes are sent to the client.  

  Otherwise, it's not going to have the interactive asynchronous property I need.

  This would work like invalidateLater(10):

  invalidateYield()

  It would not in itself invalidate the reactive, but it would force any pending invalidation to defer until after all current data was sent to the client.

-Alex

messages.subject: Re: invalidateYield
parts:
Quick inspection looks useful, but I'm more looking for 'mustn't_invalidate_until_later(ms).

If ms is 0 then it won't invalidate until all other stuff is uploaded to browser.

Another way to look at this is a suspended output which is auto un-suspended after the last lot of data is sent to the browser .
